definition_zh: 轨枕下部及周围承担支承作用的道砟层。
usage_overview: 道床通过道砟颗粒与轨枕的相互作用提供支承和横向约束，可作为研究轨枕横向阻力及骨料摩擦影响的结构对象。

complete_examples.text: The resistance contributions offered by the base, the crib, and the shoulder to the total resistance of the ballast bed have been identified in Ref. [3-6], and all studies showed a minimum contribution of 60%-70% for both base and crib zones with the friction mechanisms between the sleeper and ballast.
Firstly, the DEM model of the sleeper-ballast bed is introduced and described.
